# D7VK

The 32-bit D7VK DLL from [Universal Mod](https://github.com/Kyr4l/ei-universal-mod/tree/master/resources/universal-mod/d7vk),
D7VK 3.1.1 with its present-before-download patch. Distributed under the included zlib/libpng license.

Bundled beside `um.dll` under its original name, `d7vk.dll`. UM's `DDRAW_DLL=auto` selects it under Wine and uses
the game's DirectDraw on Windows.
